snippet.title: Clover's Quadrants release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
A challenging puzzle game where you are what you eat - and you have four stomachs. Your four directions of movement are also inventory slots, and items in those slots will affect only that direction of movement.

Clover's Quadrants by Two-Headed Deer is releasing June 26th, 2026!

Clover's Quadrants in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/clovers-quadrants/
Clover's Quadrants on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3191170/Clovers_Quadrants/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
